content: For closed/invite-only SaaS with a small known group, admin-created accounts plus an invite link (or admin sets initial credentials directly) is standard; invited users should skip cold-signup onboarding since they already know the product. Invitations should be expirable/revocable. Source: Auth0, WorkOS, Userpilot blog posts on B2B SaaS onboarding (vendor blogs, general pattern, not audited).
